entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support'.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is 788-B45.

Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... I see the Mountain Bike shoes purchased on December 16th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit. I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. I can't use them.

I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to confirm, was there any issue with installing the cleats or just the fit of the cycling shoes themselves?
The cleats were fine. The shoes just don't work for my feet. So, can I get a refund or not?
Yes, absolutely. I see the delivery was 13 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. I've just initiated the return process for you.

I've sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the item, we'll process your full refund back to the original payment method.
Alright, fine. I'll get that done. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
